Comparison.heading: Why Clients Choose T1
Comparison.t1Feature1: End-to-end service from concept design to final installation with a single point of contact.
Comparison.t1Feature2: In-house manufacturing ensures precision, quality control and faster turnaround times.
Comparison.t1Feature3: European-grade materials sourced directly, cutting out middlemen and reducing costs.
Comparison.t1Feature4: Dedicated project manager assigned from day one through to handover.
Comparison.t1Feature5: Full after-sales support and warranty on all installed joinery and furniture.
Comparison.luxuryFeature1: High-end finishes and materials but often with limited customisation options.
Comparison.luxuryFeature2: Longer lead times due to overseas manufacturing and import logistics.
Comparison.luxuryFeature3: Premium pricing driven by brand markup rather than material value.
Comparison.luxuryFeature4: Multiple contractors involved, increasing risk of miscommunication.
Comparison.luxuryFeature5: After-sales service varies and is often handled by third parties.
Comparison.budgetFeature1: Lower upfront cost but limited material quality and design flexibility.
Comparison.budgetFeature2: Shorter warranty periods and reduced durability over time.
Comparison.budgetFeature3: Cookie-cutter designs with minimal bespoke or custom options.
Comparison.budgetFeature4: Installation managed externally with no dedicated oversight.
Comparison.budgetFeature5: Limited after-sales support; repairs and replacements at extra cost.

Faq.q2: What types of spaces does T1 Studio design?

Faq.q3: How long does a typical project take from consultation to completion?

SpaceDetail.kitchen_heroDescription: From bespoke island kitchens to open-plan entertaining spaces, we craft precision-made kitchens built around the way you live and cook.
SpaceDetail.kitchen_overviewDescription: Every kitchen we design begins with a conversation about how you live. We then translate that vision into a precision-crafted space using the finest European cabinetry, stone surfaces and integrated appliances — delivered on time, on budget, and built to last.
SpaceDetail.kitchen_heroImageAlt: Luxury bespoke kitchen with marble island and pendant lighting
SpaceDetail.wardrobes_heroDescription: Custom-designed wardrobes and fitted closets engineered around your wardrobe, your workflow and your space.
SpaceDetail.wardrobes_overviewHeading: A Wardrobe Designed Around Your Life
SpaceDetail.wardrobes_overviewDescription: We design every wardrobe from scratch — mapping your clothing collection, daily routine and available space into a precisely built storage solution with premium finishes, integrated lighting and hardware that lasts.
SpaceDetail.wardrobes_heroImageAlt: Elegant walk-in wardrobe with LED lighting and full-length mirror
SpaceDetail.livingRooms_heroDescription: Sophisticated living spaces designed to balance effortless comfort with your personal aesthetic.
SpaceDetail.livingRooms_overviewHeading: Spaces That Invite You to Stay
SpaceDetail.livingRooms_overviewDescription: Our living room designs bring together bespoke furniture, curated materials and considered spatial planning to create interiors that feel both refined and genuinely lived-in — crafted for the way your household moves through the day.
SpaceDetail.livingRooms_heroImageAlt: Contemporary living room with neutral tones, woven wall art and natural textures
SpaceDetail.bedrooms_heroDescription: Thoughtfully designed bedrooms that blend premium finishes, calming atmosphere and personalized storage.
SpaceDetail.bedrooms_overviewDescription: We treat the bedroom as the most personal room in the home. Every detail — from integrated headboard joinery to concealed storage and ambient lighting — is considered as part of a unified design that promotes calm and reflects your individual taste.
SpaceDetail.bedrooms_heroImageAlt: Luxury modern bedroom with warm lighting, premium finishes and custom furniture
SpaceDetail.bathrooms_heroDescription: Refined bathroom spaces crafted with premium stone, smart storage and a calm, spa-like atmosphere.
SpaceDetail.bathrooms_overviewHeading: The Spa You Come Home To
SpaceDetail.bathrooms_overviewDescription: We design bathrooms that feel like a private retreat. Premium stone surfaces, freestanding and bespoke vanities, heated towel rails and precisely positioned lighting are brought together into a space that balances function with daily indulgence.
SpaceDetail.bathrooms_heroImageAlt: Modern luxury bathroom with stone finishes and elegant fixtures
SpaceDetail.homeOffice_heroDescription: Functional, inspiring home offices designed to sharpen focus and elevate your work from home experience.
SpaceDetail.homeOffice_overviewDescription: A well-designed home office is more than a desk in a spare room. We create fully fitted, purpose-built workspaces with custom joinery, integrated cable management, acoustic consideration and lighting designed to support deep focus across a full working day.
SpaceDetail.homeOffice_heroImageAlt: Modern home office with custom desk and built-in storage
SpaceDetail.outdoorLiving_heroDescription: Elegant outdoor areas designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, relaxing and entertaining.
SpaceDetail.outdoorLiving_overviewDescription: From covered terraces and alfresco dining areas to bespoke outdoor kitchens and pool decks, we design outdoor living spaces that feel as considered and comfortable as the rooms inside — built to UAE climate standards and finished to a luxury specification.
SpaceDetail.outdoorLiving_heroImageAlt: Luxury outdoor living area with modern seating and ambient lighting
SpaceDetail.bespokeJoinery_heroDescription: Precision-crafted joinery solutions that maximize space, functionality and architectural character.
SpaceDetail.bespokeJoinery_overviewHeading: Crafted With Purpose, Built to Last
SpaceDetail.bespokeJoinery_overviewDescription: Our joinery workshop produces custom-built pieces — from wall panelling and media units to library shelving and built-in storage — entirely tailored to your space. Every piece is designed in our studio and crafted using premium materials with exacting standards of fit and finish.
SpaceDetail.bespokeJoinery_heroImageAlt: Custom bespoke joinery with premium wood finishes and integrated storage

Accessibility.heading: Accessibility
Accessibility.description: We want every visitor to be able to use our website comfortably, whatever their ability or the device they use.
Accessibility.section1Body:
A great kitchen is one that works for everyone who uses it, and we believe the same about our website. T.One Universal Studio LLC ("T1 Studio", "we", "us") wants every visitor to be able to browse our kitchens, wardrobes, vanities and projects, and to book a design session, whatever their ability or the device they use.

This statement applies to t1-studio.com and explains the standard we work to, where we may still fall short, and how to tell us if something gets in your way.
Accessibility.section2Body:
We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at Level AA, the internationally recognised benchmark for accessible websites. These guidelines also support the UAE's wider commitment to inclusion for People of Determination.

In practice, this means we have designed the site so that you can:
Accessibility.std1: Navigate every page using a keyboard alone, with a visible focus outline showing where you are.
Accessibility.std2: Use a screen reader, with a logical heading structure, descriptive link text and labelled form fields.
Accessibility.std3: Read text with enough contrast against its background, and zoom up to 200% without losing content.
Accessibility.std4: Understand images through alternative text, with purely decorative images hidden from assistive technology.
Accessibility.std5: Use the site comfortably on a phone, tablet or desktop, in portrait or landscape.
Accessibility.std6: Turn off or avoid motion, as we keep animation to a minimum and respect your device's reduced-motion setting.
Accessibility.std7: Fill in our booking and contact forms with clear instructions and error messages that explain how to fix a problem.
Accessibility.section2Note: We test the site with automated tools and manual checks before major releases, and review it again as new pages and features are added.
Accessibility.section3Title: Where We May Still Fall Short
Accessibility.section3Body: We are honest about the fact that no website is perfect, and some parts of ours may not yet fully meet WCAG 2.2 AA:
Accessibility.short1Body: Some older images may have limited alternative text while we update them.
Accessibility.short2Body: Embedded videos from YouTube, the WhatsApp chat button, Google Maps and Google reviews are provided by other companies, so we cannot fully control how accessible they are.
Accessibility.short3Body: Older brochures or catalogues may not be fully readable by screen readers. We are happy to send the same information in another format.
Accessibility.short4Body: Visual design features may not be fully usable with assistive technology. Our designers can walk you through the same choices by phone, video call or in person.
Accessibility.section3Note: If any of these affects you, please contact us and we will provide the information another way.
Accessibility.section4Body:
Our service doesn't end on screen. If you are planning a visit to our showroom at Showroom 1, MSM 2 Building, Exit 44, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, let us know in advance if you need any help and we will do our best to make your visit comfortable.

We can also hold your design consultation by phone, WhatsApp or video call, or arrange a home visit if travelling to us is difficult. And when we design your kitchen, we are glad to plan around specific needs, such as adjusted counter heights, easy-reach storage or wheelchair-friendly layouts.
Accessibility.section5Title: Tell Us If Something Isn't Working
Accessibility.section5Body: If you have trouble using any part of this website, or need information in a different format, please tell us. Your feedback helps us improve, and we read every message.
Accessibility.contact4: Visit: Showroom 1, MSM 2 Building, Exit 44, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai
Accessibility.contact5: Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm; Saturday, 9am to 2pm
Accessibility.section5Note: To help us fix the issue quickly, please include the page address, what you were trying to do, and the device, browser or assistive technology you were using. We aim to reply within 2 working days and to resolve or offer an alternative within 10 working days.
Accessibility.faq1Q: Is the T1 Studio website accessible?
Accessibility.faq1A: We aim to meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA across t1-studio.com. A few areas, mainly third-party content and older images, may not fully meet it yet, and we are working on them.
Accessibility.faq2Q: Can I book a kitchen design consultation without using the website?
Accessibility.faq2A: Yes. You can book by phone on +971 4 238 6488, by WhatsApp on +971 50 608 1467, or in person at our Sheikh Zayed Road showroom.
Accessibility.faq3Q: Is the T1 Studio showroom wheelchair accessible?
Accessibility.faq3A: If you let us know before your visit, our team will help make sure you can get around comfortably.
Accessibility.faq4Q: Can you design a kitchen for someone with mobility needs?
Accessibility.faq4A: Yes. Every kitchen we make is custom, so we can adjust counter heights, storage placement and layout to suit the people who use it.
Accessibility.faq5Q: How do I report an accessibility problem on the website?
Accessibility.faq5A: Email, call or WhatsApp us using the details above. Tell us the page, the problem and the device or assistive technology you used, and we will get back to you.

CookiePolicy.heading: Cookie Policy
CookiePolicy.description: We want you to understand exactly what is stored on your device, why, and how to stay in control of it.
CookiePolicy.section1Body:
This Cookie Policy explains how T.One Universal Studio LLC ("T1 Studio", "we", "us") uses cookies and similar technologies on t1-studio.com. We want you to understand exactly what is stored on your device, why, and how to stay in control of it.

We follow the UAE Personal Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021) and, where it applies to visitors from the EU or UK, the GDPR. This policy should be read alongside our Privacy Policy, which explains how we handle personal data more generally.

Last updated: 1st October, 2026
CookiePolicy.section2Body:
Cookies are small text files that a website saves on your phone, tablet or computer when you visit. They let the site remember things, like your cookie choices, and help us understand which pages are useful so we can make them better.

Some cookies are set by us (first-party cookies). Others are set by trusted partners whose tools we use, such as Google or Meta (third-party cookies). We also use similar technologies, such as pixels and tags, which work in much the same way; in this policy, "cookies" covers all of them.

Cookies can last for the length of your visit (session cookies) or stay on your device for a set period (persistent cookies).
CookiePolicy.section3Body: We group our cookies into four categories. Only strictly necessary cookies are switched on by default; everything else waits for your permission.
CookiePolicy.cat1Body: Why: Keep the site secure and working, load pages correctly, and remember your cookie choices. Examples: Cookie consent preference, security and load-balancing cookies. Duration: Session to 12 months. Consent required: No — the site cannot work without them.
CookiePolicy.cat2Body: Why: Remember your preferences and power features such as the WhatsApp chat button, embedded maps and videos. Examples: WhatsApp chat widget, Google Maps, YouTube. Duration: Session to 6 months. Consent required: Yes.
CookiePolicy.cat3Body: Why: Show us, in aggregate, how visitors find and use the site so we can improve it. Examples: Google Analytics 4 (_ga, _ga*), managed through Google Tag Manager. Duration: Up to 24 months. Consent required: Yes.
CookiePolicy.cat4Body: Why: Measure our advertising and show you relevant T1 Studio ads on other sites and social media. Examples: Google Ads, Meta Pixel (_fbp), LinkedIn Insight, TikTok Pixel. Duration: Up to 24 months. Consent required: Yes.
CookiePolicy.section3Note: We never use cookies to sell your personal data. Where a third party sets a cookie, its use is governed by that provider's own privacy policy, which you can find on their website.
CookiePolicy.section4Title: Your Choices and How to Change Them
CookiePolicy.section4Body:
When you first visit our website, a cookie banner lets you accept all cookies, reject all non-essential cookies, or choose category by category. Rejecting cookies is as easy as accepting them, and saying no won't stop you from browsing our kitchens or booking a design session.

You can change your mind at any time:
CookiePolicy.choice1: On our site: click "Cookie settings" in the website footer to update or withdraw your consent.
CookiePolicy.choice2: In your browser: most browsers let you block or delete cookies in their settings. Guides are available for Chrome, Safari, Firefox and Edge.
CookiePolicy.choice3: For Google Analytics: you can install the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on.
CookiePolicy.section4Note: Please note that blocking strictly necessary cookies may stop parts of the site from working properly. Withdrawing consent does not affect any use of cookies before you withdrew it.
CookiePolicy.section5Body:
Some cookies collect information that counts as personal data, such as an online identifier. Under the UAE PDPL, and the GDPR where it applies, you have the right to ask what data we hold about you, to have it corrected or deleted, to object to or restrict how we use it, and to withdraw your consent at any time. Our Privacy Policy explains these rights in full and how we respond to requests.

Some of our partners may process data outside the UAE. Where that happens, we rely on the safeguards permitted by law to protect it.
CookiePolicy.section6Body: We may update this policy when we add new features, change partners or when the law changes. The "Last updated" date at the top tells you when it last changed, and if a change is significant we will ask for your consent again.
CookiePolicy.section7Body: If you have a question about cookies or your data, we're happy to help.
CookiePolicy.contact4: Address: Showroom 1, MSM 2 Building, Exit 44, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE
CookiePolicy.faq1Q: Does the T1 Studio website use cookies?
CookiePolicy.faq1A: Yes. We use strictly necessary cookies to run the site and, only with your consent, functional, analytics and marketing cookies.
CookiePolicy.faq2Q: Can I use the website if I reject cookies?
CookiePolicy.faq2A: Yes. You can browse every page and book a design session with non-essential cookies switched off. Some embedded features, such as maps, videos or the WhatsApp chat button, may not load until you allow them.
CookiePolicy.faq3Q: How do I change my cookie settings?
CookiePolicy.faq3A: Click "Cookie settings" in the website footer at any time. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings.
CookiePolicy.faq4Q: Does T1 Studio sell my data?
CookiePolicy.faq4A: No. We never sell personal data collected through cookies.
CookiePolicy.faq5Q: How long do cookies stay on my device?
CookiePolicy.faq5A: Session cookies are deleted when you close your browser. Persistent cookies last from a few days up to 24 months, depending on their purpose, unless you delete them sooner.

TermsConditions.sub3_1Body: Keller Keukens B.V. provides a 5-year full warranty covering the quality of the kitchen units and elements manufactured and supplied by Keller. TermsConditions.sub3_2Body: Defects or flaws in the kitchen units must be reported to the dealer within four working weeks by sending an e-mail to dealers@kellerkeukens.nl. Reports must be accompanied by the order number and a clear photo(s) of the problem.

TermsConditions.sub3_5A: A. Any materials not produced by Keller and materials supplied by third parties, such as kitchen appliances, worktops, tapware, accessories and tiles. For these items, the warranty of the individual manufacturer applies.
TermsConditions.sub3_5B: B. Damage resulting from: external forces (damage during transport after delivery by Keller, or from knocks or bumps); careless usage or maintenance; use of abrasives and/or aggressive cleaning agents; normal wear and tear; ageing and discolouration caused by smoke, light, or sunlight; defects from excessive load; heat in excess of the AMK norm of 70°C for cooking and baking appliances and dishwashers; excessive humidity or vapour; damage caused by defective pipework (gas, water, electricity); poorly functioning, improperly installed, or incorrectly operated equipment; or extreme changes in humidity (relative humidity persistently higher or lower than 45–70%) or insufficient ventilation.
TermsConditions.gen_A: A. The fronts of units may warp as a result of insufficient ventilation, incorrect installation, defrosting water, or trailing power leads to the refrigerator or freezer. Warping permitted to factory standards is 2.5 mm/m¹.
TermsConditions.gen_B: B. Across the wide range of raw materials used, colour, décor, and structure are matched as closely as possible. PrivacyPolicy.heading: Privacy Policy

However, we may share your information with our service providers who assist us in providing our services. PrivacyPolicy.section6Body: If you have any questions or concerns about our privacy policy or the way we handle your personal information, please contact us at
